title: Health Resort east wing office room 107 key

infobox.usage: Unlocks office 107 of the East wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Health Resort east wing office room 107 key (E107 San) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Azure Coast sanatorium east wing office room 107.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text: - Second floor of the Admin building: In the band room on a chair in the first row

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: First floor of the East wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- One Medbag
- One Medcase
- One Sport bag
- One LEDX spawn
- One Graphics Card spawn
- Loose loot (Money, Meds, Electronics)
